THE STRUCTURE: sugar is only ~14% of EBITDA and now STRUCTURALLY capped (TRQ 100kt, Astarta's allocation ~22kt, marginal tonne world-priced at ~EUR430 vs EU ~EUR502) — but the -76% headline was dairy(-78%)+soy(-62%)+IAS-41 non-cash fair-value; OCF stayed +EUR36m. War: key plants in Poltava/Vinnytsia/Khmelnytskyi (safe oblasts); biogas resilience; the tail is LOGISTICS. Register: Ivanchyk 43.2% + Fairfax 29.9%, float ~25%. Elasticity: peace beta REAL but FRONT-LOADED and partly spent (Feb-25 +29%/wk, ~64 peak, round-tripped; Geneva giveback only -2 to -9% = favorable asymmetry). FV PLN 58-60 (+27%), skew favorable (-15% / +50-80%).
